name: Proof microcopy near the CTA
definition: One short line of evidence, such as an avatar stack and a recent count, placed right beside the main call to action.
bestUse: Reducing hesitation at the moment of sign-up without adding a section.

demo.how: Proof works best where the doubt happens, so one line of evidence sits under the button instead of in a far-away section. Play shows the form, then the avatar stack and recent count with its no-card reassurance. The number is illustrative and should come from real, current data.
